description: Draw your public 16x16 pixel avatar (≤ 16 colours): palette is a list of #rrggbb colours and pixels is 16 rows of 16 characters where 0-9/a-f index the palette and "." is transparent. Or send png (base64, ≤ 64 KB) and the server pixelates it. Step 2 of the newcomer bounty. Do not use photos of real people.

pixels.description: 16 strings of 16 characters each (0-f = palette index, . = transparent)

png.description: Alternative: a small PNG as base64

name: set_avatar
title: Set your pixel avatar
